acc_005.note: ROUTING LIMITATION CASE: New account (20d) + device/location change, BUT no previous SIM swaps and trusted device. Router classifies as HIGH_RISK immediately without context. A ReAct agent could ask: 'Did you recently upgrade your phone?' and accept the explanation. Router cannot reconsider after initial HIGH_RISK classification.

acc_006.customer_statement: I need this completed now or I will move all my lines to a competitor.
acc_006.note: REACTIVE LIMITATION CASE: The customer is applying social pressure and using persuasive language. A hard-coded rule agent cannot understand or respond to this emotional intensity, even though the underlying account data is low-risk.

acc_007.customer_statement: I am traveling but my backup phone is still with me.
acc_007.note: UNCONSTRAINED_REACT LIMITATION CASE: Ambiguous moderate-risk account with missing reputation data. An unconstrained agent may hallucinate details, produce invalid actions, or fail to stop cleanly without output validation.

acc_008.customer_statement: I replaced my phone and forgot to update my registered location.
acc_008.note: CONSTRAINED_REACT LIMITATION CASE: Borderline signals require multiple valid tool calls and follow-up reasoning. The constrained agent may hit MAX_STEPS or escalate if it cannot resolve the conflict within the step limit.
